description: The silent half of the hedging pair. Identical to pair-hedge-stated.txt except for clause 9.1, which drops the words about payment for the restriction. Duration, geographic scope and industry scope are still stated; whether the restriction is compensated is not, so ADR 0006's trigger fires and the finding must be hedged naming that property. Severity is unchanged between the halves, because a hedge never lowers severity — the unstated property is assumed at its dangerous end.
engagement: Four marketing campaigns for the Sender's three restaurant sites at £3,400 a month, running from 13 April to 9 October 2026.

planted.sourceSentence: 9.1 For twelve (12) months after the end of the Term, the Contractor shall not provide marketing services to any business in the hospitality sector anywhere in the United Kingdom.
planted.why: ADR 0006: the contract does not say whether the restriction is separately compensated, so the finding is hedged and the hedge must name that property. Severity stays at 3 because the unstated property is assumed at its dangerous end, matching pair-hedge-stated.txt.
